function setPlan(planEl){var selectElement=document.querySelector("select.dn-selling-plans"),selectedOption=selectElement.options[selectElement.selectedIndex],planPrice=selectedOption.dataset.price,selectedValue=selectedOption.value,createInput=document.createElement("input");createInput.type="hidden",createInput.classList.add("selling_plan"),createInput.setAttribute("name","selling_plan"),createInput.value=selectedValue;var getActivePlan=planEl.dataset.plan,form=document.querySelector(".shopify-product-form"),existingInput=form.querySelector(".selling_plan");existingInput&&existingInput.remove(),getActivePlan=="subscription plan"?(form.appendChild(createInput),document.querySelector("span.plan_price.subscribe_price").innerText=planPrice):getActivePlan=="one time"}var planClass=document.querySelectorAll(".purchase_plan");planClass.length>0&&planClass.forEach(function(planEl){planEl.addEventListener("click",function(){planClass.forEach(function(el){el.classList.remove("active")}),planEl.classList.add("active"),setPlan(planEl)})});
